history.overview: The Trial of Adaptation tests combatants’ ability to survive rapidly changing terrain, hazards, and enemy compositions.

timeline.name: Adaptive Arena Design
timeline.description: Muramite engineers created a modular arena capable of shifting layouts.

timeline.name: Flux Mechanisms
timeline.description: Discord pylons were added to trigger environmental changes.

timeline.name: Dragorn Adaptation Trials
timeline.description: Dragorn captives were forced into unpredictable combat scenarios.

timeline.name: Discord Flux Integration
timeline.description: Discord flux storms were harnessed to destabilize the arena further.
